column4: Identical locked camera, cathedral nave, pews, statues and steps as the first reference, but now both tall doors have been swung wide open against the side walls, showing their inner faces with the ironwork. The whole doorway opening between the open doors, from the threshold up to the pointed arch, is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing at all visible inside it. The floor and carpet inside the nave stay unchanged. No people, no text.
